answer: A concrete sybil defense: influence requires an account to accumulate and keep a non-transferable history of honest grading, epoch after epoch. An attacker's clones burn bright like a passing comet - cheap to launch, quick to fade - while real standing must be tended like an orchard that yields only after seasons of care. Any detected duplicate drags the whole cluster into a downward spiral of distrust, so flooding identities multiplies risk instead of reward. Effort, not count, is what the economy prices.
